claim_under_attack: Explicit live component-cut distance is causally useful for selecting productive source-law instances under scarce budget; the effect is not merely due to deterministic ordering or selecting any unusual subset of the same pool.
frozen_candidate_pool: Exactly the 35 candidates and deterministic metadata produced by methodology-0036-cut-ranking-tournament-v1. No new candidates, fills, anchors, proof rules, term cap, or reentry edges.

arms.A_CUT_BLIND_TARGET: same target-subterm-coverage ranking used in the parent ablation
arms.C_WRONG_DIRECTION_CUT: descending predicted opposite-component distance, with the same deterministic tie break

primary_statistic: first K producing strict contraction below 10

decision_table.CUT_SIGNAL_CAUSAL: B contracts strictly earlier than both A and C, and C does not match B at the first B-success budget.
decision_table.ORDERING_CONFOUND: C contracts as early as B despite ranking in the explicitly wrong direction, or A/C match B's trajectory through K=12.
decision_table.CUT_SIGNAL_WEAK: B retains some advantage but does not satisfy the strict causal criterion.
decision_table.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: the frozen 35-candidate pool, 15 contractors, cut 10, 4/19 component sizes, cap 19, or 9 reentry edges cannot be reproduced.

next_if_causal: DESCAFFOLD: replace access to target-labelled component sides with a derivable graph-state objective using only the two unresolved goal endpoints and current equality components; then test whether the same ranking emerges. Do not expose transfer cases before descaffolding.
